Standard: The minimum design reliability of the air vehicle escape system is at least 98%. The design reliability of the escape system is calculated from the reliability data of the elements and components in the operating environment. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Reliability analysis shows that the escape system meets the standard using design analysis and data for all escape system functional subsystems and components in the intended operating environment.
